notes:
POC focused on Dedicated capacity sizing + traffic shaping. Primary ask: guaranteed baseline throughput for personalization use case (low-latency reranking + real-time recommend). Target: sustained 200 qps across 3 routes; burst up to 350 qps for short windows. Latency SLOs requested by CTO: p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 350ms (tail guarantees are critical).

They currently operate a multi-tenant microservice that issues embedding + reranking calls per user action; noisy tenants in internal tests caused 2-3x token cost and latency spikes. Team quote: "If we can't guarantee tail latency under mixed load we can't move off our autoscaled infra."

Key asks recorded in call:
- Per-tenant priority lanes: ability to mark traffic as high/low priority and guarantee slot reservations.
- Per-route quotas and burst buckets: different SLAs per route (re-rank vs embeddings).
- Noisy-neighbor controls: automatic tenant throttling, fair scheduling, preemptible lower-tier lanes.
- Reserved GPU planning: baseline reserve of 8 A100 equiv + 50% burst capacity; want deterministic mapping from reserved count to expected qps.
- SLA negotiation: specific language around throughput guarantees, maintenance windows, and credits tied to p99 breaches.

Attached artifacts (drive): dedicated-sla-workbook.xlsx = GPU sizing & cost model; security-faq.pdf = items security escalated. Rafael leading technical follow-up. Procurement wants final pricing sheet before legal signs SOW.
technical_requirements_summary: Workload: real-time recommendation + reranking. Expected traffic pattern: diurnal with sudden campaign spikes (burst 2-3x baseline). Target throughput: baseline 200 qps, burst 350 qps. Latency targets: p95 <=150ms, p99 <=350ms. Needs per-route QoS, tenant isolation, and deterministic reserved GPU -> qps mapping. Require VPC deployment; pen test/iso27001 evidence. HSM/KMS for keys.
poc_acceptance_criteria: Sustained baseline throughput: 200 qps for 60 minutes with p95 <=150ms
Burst handling: 350 qps for 5 minutes without p99 > 400ms

Noisy neighbor scenario: lower-priority tenant throttled automatically under contention
